![How to Do A/B Testing: 15 Steps for the Perfect Split Test](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-a3c738590ea6:4)
A/B testing is a randomized experimentation method that compares two or more versions (like a control **A** and a variant **B** ) to see which one performs better on a specific metric . You can learn more about its core principles through the [Optimizely A/B Testing Guide](https://www.optimizely.com/optimization-glossary/ab-testing).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A/B_testing)[[2]](https://www.optimizely.com/optimization-glossary/ab-testing)[[3]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ab-testing/)

### How It Works

- **Audience split:** Live traffic or users are randomly divided between the original version (control) and the modified version (variant).[[1]](https://www.optimizely.com/optimization-glossary/ab-testing)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hHXEjcJkcbc)[[3]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ab-testing/)
- **Single variable:** Only one element (such as a call-to-action button color, headline, or layout) is changed at a time to isolate what drives the result.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ab-testing/)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ab-testing)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vV3g5VuSrIQ&t=9)
- **Data tracking:** User behavior and key performance indicators (like clicks or conversions) are tracked in real time.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)[[2]](https://www.oracle.com/cx/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hHXEjcJkcbc)
- **Statistical significance:** The test runs until it reaches a large enough sample size to prove the difference isn't due to random chance.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ab-testing)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zFMgpxG-chM)

### Key Benefits

- **Removes guesswork:** Replaces internal assumptions and intuition with actual user behavior data.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zFMgpxG-chM)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)[[3]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ab-testing)
- **Improves conversions:** Helps optimize websites, emails, apps, and marketing campaigns for higher engagement or sales.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vV3g5VuSrIQ&t=9)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)[[3]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ab-testing)
- **Lowers risk:** Allows small, incremental updates to be tested safely before launching them fully.[[1]](https://www.fullstory.com/blog/ab-testing/)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/what-is-ab-testing/)
